value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

value: Get ready: find the Permit Job Card, obtain inspection code(s), and have an on-site contact name and phone number

Request inspection by phone at (831) 758-7251 (Option 1) with inspection code(s) ready, or online via the eTRAKiT Portal (authorized users only; contractors may request access by emailing epermit@salinas.gov)
Choose a window: AM (8:30am-12:30pm) or PM (12:00pm-4:30pm); no exact arrival times given
To schedule for the next business day: request AM inspections by 12:00pm, PM inspections by 4:00pm
Someone 18+ must be on site during the window with City-stamped approved plans and the Permit Job Card printed and accessible
Re-inspection fees may apply for no-shows, same-day cancellations, or failed inspections; cancel at least 24 hours in advance when possible
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Inspections scheduling process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence. Inspection requests are not accepted by email or department voicemail.

timeline_days.notes: The City's own Automated Solar Permit page describes the SolarAPP+ pathway as 'streamline and expedite' the permitting process, but does not use explicit instant/automatic-issuance language, so no timeline figure was recorded per this project's evidentiary standard.

value.program_or_pathway: Automated Solar Permit via SolarAPP+ (contractors only)
other_conditions: Available exclusively to contractors registered with SolarAPP+; applies to residential roof-mounted PV installations, with or without energy storage systems
A main electrical service upgrade may optionally be included in the Automated Solar Permit application
Only systems listed in the SolarAPP+ Eligibility Checklist are eligible
